title: COP31 groups push reuse to curb waste at its source

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Environmental groups are urging governments to place greater emphasis on reducing waste at the source, saying that improved waste collection and recycling alone cannot address the environmental impact of excessive production and consumption. The call came with the launch of a new framework at the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31)
